messages:
maya: Heads-up — after promoting base-image v2.14 to eu-west we’re seeing ~8% of GPU pods fail to come up. Repro on a couple G4/G5 nodepools.
arjun: where exactly? node ids/region? any logs?
maya: eu-west-1a primarily. sample nodes: ip-10-0-12-34, ip-10-0-12-97. containerd logs show mount failures for nvidia libs.
rachel: paste the error lines please
maya: ```containerd: start_container: mounting /run/nvidia/driver/libcuda.so -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so failed: no such file or directory```
Also seeing `libnvidia-ml.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory` in container stderr.
devon: did we change the nvidia-container-toolkit/version in the image build?
maya: yep — toolkit bumped 1.9.0 -> 1.12.3 and base image switched the host bind mounts to rely on rshared propagation.
liu: that rings a bell — nodes running kernel 5.15.0-1020-aws still have host init with rprivate mounts, so bind propagation isn't making host libs visible inside the container. Toolkit 1.12 assumes rshared for symlink overlay.
arjun: infra-bot shows image v2.14 promoted to eu-west at 1823465400 by arjun. Did canary pass?
infra-bot: deploy v2.14 promoted to eu-west at 1823465400 by arjun.
rachel: mitigation options: 1) rollback to v2.13 (no toolkit change) 2) patch node init to set mountPropagation rshared (host-level change) 3) inject initContainer to create expected symlinks from host paths (hacky).
devon: quick note — NCCL smoke tests in canary also show subtle failures (hangs) on affected nodes. Probably driver/kit mismatch. Pause rollout?
arjun: rolling a rollback on impacted nodepools now. Starting drain->replace with v2.13 images.
maya: current impact: 42 GPU pods failing across 3 nodepools, job queue wait time spiked ~2.8x in last 10m.
liu: long term we should add node-level compatibility matrix check in the CI: kernel version vs driver vs toolkit vs containerd mount propagation. This upgrade should have been gated.
rachel: I'll file INC-4821 and tag infra-oncall, attach logs and node lists.
maya: devon, can you run `nvidia-smi` health check on the failed nodes and capture driver versions?
devon: on it. quick output sample: ```NVIDIA-SMI 525.116.04 Driver Version: 525.116.04 CUDA Version: 11.8 ERROR: could not load library libnvidia-ml.so.1: No such file or directory```
arjun: FYI, if we keep constant rollbacks we may double-schedule and spike spot usage/costs — watch the autoscaler churn. Escalate to oncall if >100 pods.
maya: Agreed. Action items: pause global rollout, rollback eu-west pools to v2.13, run compatibility probe across all zones, add preflight in image pipeline for mountPropagation and toolkit/driver matrix.
liu: I'll prepare the compatibility script and run in staging.
rachel: INC-4821 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821 — tagging @infra-oncall @platform.
maya: thanks — monitoring the rollback. Ping here when done. :warning:
arjun: rollback complete on first two nodepools, waiting on third to finish. will update when all drains done.
